description.value:
You can craft small charges that burst into a deeper darkness. During a short or long rest, you produce two such charges, gaining one more at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. Only you can trigger a charge, and any unused charge loses its potency at the end of your next short or long rest.

Once per turn, you may throw a charge instead of making a weapon attack or unarmed strike. It has a range of 30 feet plus five times your Strength modifier, and detonates at a point you choose within that range into a 10-foot-radius sphere of darkness that bends around corners, lasting 1 minute or until dispelled by an enhanced source of bright light.
